title: Adversary can block the counterpart deployment of cross-chain DAOs
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `deploySAFE()` function in `Deployer` attempts to create a Safe for the DAO via `SafeProxyFactory::createProxyWithNonce()`. It uses a `try/catch` pattern, but it will always revert if another Safe with the same `nonce` was created beforehand on that chain.
